rows: One row per order. Gross value is unit amount times quantity. Net value is gross value minus the sum of refund records for that order. Monetary outputs are dollars.
Unique order identifier; refund and shipment order references point here.
Customer reference, matching the customer reference in the profile table. Select one current profile per customer before joining orders.
Unit amount is stored in integer cents; divide by 100.0 to obtain dollars. A NULL unit amount means zero; retain this order in monetary averages and totals.
Positive integer quantity purchased in this order.
Order status: confirmed, cancelled, or pending. Include all statuses unless the question restricts them.
Integer day of order placement; shipment day minus this value is shipment lag in days.
Customer profiles. Historical snapshots; multiple profile rows can share a customer reference. The current profile is the unique row whose current flag equals 1; largest revision need not be current.
Unique profile-row identifier; this is not the order customer reference.
Customer reference used by orders; it may repeat across profile snapshots.
Region for this profile snapshot: North or South; use the current snapshot.
Tier for this profile snapshot: Gold or Silver; use the current snapshot.
Integer profile revision, unique within each customer.
Current flag; see the profile-table convention to decide whether it is authoritative.
Refund events. An order can have multiple records; sum refund amounts once per order before combining them with order values or shipments. Orders without refund events have zero refunds.
Order reference matching the order identifier.
Refund amount stored in integer cents; divide by 100.0 to obtain dollars; never NULL.

Shipment events. An order can have multiple records. An order is delivered if any record has delivered flag 1; no shipment records means not delivered. The latest shipment has greatest shipment day. Aggregate per order before joining other event tables.
Order reference matching the order identifier.
Integer shipment day. Use greatest shipment day per order for latest-shipment lag.
Delivery indicator, 0 or 1; any 1 for an order means delivered.
